title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Jaeger Withdraws Mid-Round
items.text: Stephan Jaeger withdrew mid-round from the $9.9 million Charles Schwab Challenge at Colonial due to a back injury confirmed by PGA Tour Communications.

items.headline: Memorial Tournament Field Set
items.text: Scottie Scheffler will defend his Memorial Tournament title at Muirfield Village on June 4, with Rory McIlroy, Xander Schauffele, Jordan Spieth, and Cameron Young also in the field; Viktor Hovland withdrew before the entry deadline.

items.headline: Golf Boosts Mental Health
items.text: Experts highlight golf's mental health benefits including stress reduction, lowered depression risk, and a 37% lower dementia risk in older adults by triggering chemicals linked to pleasure and social bonding.
